summary: This document details the administrative history of Nicolas Hernandez's appeal, which was ultimately closed and dismissed due to 'no jurisdiction'. The timeline shows various submissions, denials, acknowledgements, and dismissal requests, culminating in an administrative dismissal granted on June 22, 2026, after multiple attempts to provide supplemental evidence regarding medical necessity and statutory defaults.
